source.title: smedinx-11 is a planarian stem cell gap junction gene required for regeneration and homeostasis

intervention.description: Three injections of smedinx-11 dsRNA over two consecutive days plus one more day (32 nl pulses) into the gastrovascular system; fragments amputated 8 days after first injection

readout.method: scoring of new tissue at amputation plane

notes: Fig 3A legend: fragments failed to create new tissue (30/30) at 3 weeks. Fragment type and cut plane not stated. Control (water-injected) shows blastemas in representative image only, no counts. Text also says 100% penetrance.

source.title: smedinx-11 is a planarian stem cell gap junction gene required for regeneration and homeostasis

intervention.description: In vitro-synthesized capped mRNA encoding smedinx-11 injected into ventral blastomeres of four-cell embryos

readout.method: organ situs scoring as in Levin and Mercola 1998

notes: Methods text: 35% heterotaxia for smedinx-11 mRNA into ventral blastomeres, 'n=119' given once for both constructs (not clear if per construct or combined), so n_total null. Normal fraction not reported; remainder unstated, partial. Dorsal-blastomere injections (no effect) and non-functional mutant (P=0.3) have no numbers.
